name: print-social-customer-day-post-with-handshake-photo-and-speech-bubble-frame
title: Brazilian 'Dia do Cliente' post with a handshake photo in a speech-bubble frame and orange keywords
whatItIs: A square white post with a grey and orange headline 'NENHUMA HISTÓRIA É CONTADA SOZINHA!', a date line '15 de Setembro | Dia do Cliente', a photo of a smiling woman shaking a client's hand cropped into a rounded shape with speech-bubble tails, orange dot grids and chevrons, and an outlined orange logo box.
whatItMeans: Warm and grateful; the speech-bubble frame turns the photo into a conversation.
techniques: Crop a photo with speech-bubble tails.
Colour keywords of the headline in the accent.
Use dot grids in corners as balance.

vocabulary.definition: A photo masked with callout tails.
Accent colour on key words only.
